message.body:
Choose a cryptographically random integer NUMBER from 1 through 100 inclusive and a cryptographically random 32-byte SALT encoded as exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Keep NUMBER and SALT only in your private /tmp; do not place them in any shared/repository file and never change NUMBER. Compute the lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the exact UTF-8 byte sequence goblins-number-v1
NUMBER
SALT
, where each 
 is a real newline separator and there is a final newline, substituting the decimal NUMBER and lowercase hex SALT. Your initial reply must contain only that 64-character SHA-256 commitment, with no label, formatting, or extra text. Afterward, for every guess message, reply only with exactly one of: correct, too high, too low. Continue replying to every guess even if an earlier guess was correct. Reveal nothing else until, after exactly ten guesses, I explicitly request the reveal; then reply only as NUMBER SALT on one line. Keep this goblin alive after the reveal for host attachment.
Your reply was empty, so no commitment was received. Reply with only the previously computed 64-character lowercase SHA-256 commitment. Keep the original NUMBER and SALT unchanged.
Reveal NUMBER and SALT now in the required one-line format: NUMBER SALT.
